title: Museum Siam — claimed by thegentlemen
description: TH · Hospitality · museumsiam.org Museum Siam museum in Bangkok run by NDMI under the public organization OKMD — the .org domain is real, but it's a government institute, not a private company. It occupies the former Ministry of Commerce building (1921–1922) and opened as a museum on 2 April 2008.
